measures.item: borrowed tripod's quick-release clamp (the slot the plate slides into)
measures.what: the inside width of the slot at the top, i.e. the gap between the two lips/overhangs that hold the plate down
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.what: the inside width of the slot at its floor (below the lips), if it differs from the top gap
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.what: the depth from the top surface of the clamp down to the floor the plate rests on
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.what: the length from just under the head to the tip of the thread
measures.reply: webcam bolt head across: about 15 mm (its head); webcam bolt head height: about 5 mm (its head); webcam bolt length: about 10 mm (under the head)

measures.what: the head: its width across the flats if it is a hex head, otherwise its diameter
measures.reply: webcam bolt head across: about 15 mm (its head); webcam bolt head height: about 5 mm (its head)

measures.what: the head thickness, and roughly how deep the threaded socket in the camera is
measures.reply: webcam bolt head across: about 15 mm (its head); webcam bolt head height: about 5 mm (its head)

measures.what: the depth of the slot inside, from the top face of the clamp jaws down to the metal floor the plate sits on
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.what: how far each retaining lip overhangs inward over the slot (the width of the lip's underside, from the side wall to the lip's inner edge)
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.what: the shape of the head — is it a hex head, or a round knurled thumb knob, or something else — and does it have a coin slot or a hex/screwdriver recess
measures.reply: webcam bolt head across: about 15 mm (its head); webcam bolt head height: about 5 mm (its head)

measures.what: how deep the 1/4-20 threaded hole in the camera base is (or if you can't measure it, how many turns of the bolt go in before it bottoms out)
measures.reply: tripod clamp style: jaws with angled lips, tightened by a knob; the plate drops in from above; tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes); camera socket thread: 1/4-20 (the usual camera thread)

measures.what: with the knob slackened off, lay a straight edge or the caliper tail across the top of the jaws and measure straight down to the floor of the pocket that the plate sits on (the pocket depth)
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.what: is there any groove, slot or hole in the floor of the pocket that something sticking out of the plate's underside could drop into? If yes, roughly how wide, long and deep
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.what: the length of the pocket along the direction the camera faces, from the front wall to the back wall (or is it open front-to-back)
measures.reply: tripod clamp style: jaws with angled lips, tightened by a knob; the plate drops in from above; tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.what: what the head looks like: is it a knurled round knob you grip with fingers, a hex head for a spanner, or a screw head with a coin slot / hex socket / cross recess
measures.reply: webcam bolt head across: about 15 mm (its head); webcam bolt head height: about 5 mm (its head)

measures.item: fit_a coupon — the one whose WIDE face (about 37.6 mm) is up and whose edges slope down and inward to a narrow base (about 25.6 mm)
measures.what: slacken the clamp knob, drop it in: does it sit down on the pocket floor, and when you tighten the knob is it held firmly (no rocking, no sliding, no lifting out by hand)?
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.what: with it dropped in and the knob snug, how far does its top face sit above the top of the clamp's jaws (measure down from the coupon's top face to the jaws' top face)
measures.reply: tripod clamp style: jaws with angled lips, tightened by a knob; the plate drops in from above; tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.item: fit_b coupon — the one whose NARROW face (about 25.6 mm) is up and whose edges slope down and outward to a wide base (about 37.6 mm)
measures.what: slacken the clamp knob, drop it in: does it sit down on the pocket floor, and when you tighten the knob is it held firmly (no rocking, no sliding, no lifting out by hand)?
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.item: either coupon with the salvaged webcam bolt pushed fully home into the pocket on its underside
